chosen_by: Claude, 2026-10-26, for Jeff to check (docs/plans/v2-tautomers-resonance.md, bar A.3)
how: Written by reading each structure against RDKit's rules with decision 2's settings (ALLOW_CHARGE_SEPARATION, KEKULE_ALL). Most were seen in the planning probes first, so it is a review, not a blind prediction. For each compound: what the panel lists, how many structures, whether the drawing as drawn is among them, and every place a charge goes (element and sign, one entry per atom). RDKit runs on each drawing in its canonical atom order (Jeff's decision, 2026-10-26), since its search depends on the atom order. 'exist' is a chemist's count where RDKit's still falls short: it misses some equivalent structures. A test compares the generated tests/fixtures/resonance_expected.json with this file.

compounds.name: acetate
compounds.why: the charge on either oxygen

compounds.name: formate
compounds.why: as acetate

compounds.name: benzoate
compounds.why: the carboxylate's two, each with either Kekulé ring; the ring takes no charge

compounds.name: acetylacetonate
compounds.why: the charge on either oxygen, and the central carbanion

compounds.name: phenolate
compounds.why: O- with each Kekulé ring, and the two ortho and the para carbanions

compounds.name: 4-nitrophenolate
compounds.why: the nitro group's two with either Kekulé ring, and the quinoid nitronate; RDKit allows a carbanion only where its group holds no positive charge, so with the N+ the ring carbanions are left out

compounds.name: carbonate
compounds.why: the double bond to each oxygen

compounds.name: nitrate
compounds.why: the double bond to each oxygen

compounds.name: azide
compounds.why: N-=N+=N- and the two N#N+-N(2-) forms (the minor ones)

compounds.name: cyclopentadienide
compounds.why: the charge on each carbon, but RDKit misses one of the five, in its canonical order too

compounds.name: acetamide
compounds.why: the amide and its N+=C-O- form (charge separation, decision 2)

compounds.name: N-methylacetamide
compounds.why: as acetamide

compounds.name: hexaglycine
compounds.why: each of its five amides drawn either way: 2^5

compounds.name: nitromethane
compounds.why: the double bond to either oxygen

compounds.name: nitrobenzene
compounds.why: the nitro group's two with either Kekulé ring; RDKit allows a ring carbocation only where its group's total charge is positive, so none here

compounds.name: pyridine N-oxide
compounds.why: the two Kekulé rings; the ring carbanion forms are left out (decision 6)

compounds.name: ozone
compounds.why: the double bond to either end

compounds.name: diazomethane
compounds.why: only CH2=N+=N-: the CH2- form needs UNCONSTRAINED_ANIONS (decision 2)

compounds.name: guanidinium
compounds.why: the double bond to each nitrogen

compounds.name: tropylium
compounds.why: the charge on each carbon, but RDKit misses one of the seven, in its canonical order too

compounds.name: benzene
compounds.why: the two Kekulé structures (KEKULE_ALL)

compounds.name: naphthalene
compounds.why: its three Kekulé structures

compounds.name: anthracene
compounds.why: its four Kekulé structures

compounds.name: kekulene
compounds.why: 200 Kekulé structures (planning probe): too many to draw

compounds.name: aniline
compounds.why: the two Kekulé rings only (decision 6)

compounds.name: methyl vinyl ketone
compounds.why: no C+-C=C-O- form with these settings (decision 6)

compounds.name: acetic acid
compounds.why: no charge-separated form (decision 6)

compounds.name: carbon dioxide
compounds.why: no charge-separated form

compounds.name: sulfate
compounds.why: hypervalent S is outside RDKit's conjugated groups

compounds.name: buckminsterfullerene
compounds.why: one conjugated group of 90 bonds: more than 60 (decision 7)

compounds.name: acetone enolate
compounds.why: the carbanion and the enolate

compounds.name: allyl anion
compounds.why: the charge at either end

compounds.name: allyl cation
compounds.why: the charge at either end

compounds.name: benzyl cation
compounds.why: CH2+ with either Kekulé ring, and the ortho and para ring cations

compounds.name: benzenium (arenium ion)
compounds.why: the charge ortho, ortho and para to the CH2

compounds.name: methyl vinyl ketone, drawn charge-separated
compounds.why: drawn as RDKit's own C+-C=C-O- form under wider settings; with decision 2's RDKit lists only the neutral enone, so the panel says the drawing is not among its structures

compounds.name: pyrylium
compounds.why: RDKit's rules rule out every structure: each with C+ has a carbon short of an octet, which they drop while a structure with full octets exists, and each with O+ has a cation right of N, which they drop while a structure without one exists; so the panel says none are listed

compounds.name: benzene, drawn with aromatic bonds
compounds.why: as benzene; a ring drawn aromatic is like either Kekulé structure, so both are the drawing

compounds.name: phenolate, drawn with aromatic bonds
compounds.why: as phenolate

compounds.name: pyridine bound to copper
compounds.why: pyridine's two Kekulé structures; the N-Cu bond, drawn single and read by RDKit as dative, takes no part
